title: Half the coordinates, half the loss?
hook: Decode a one-number description and inspect what disappears.

knows: The listed prerequisite concepts and small arithmetic.
doesNotKnow: Compute projection reconstruction error and retained variance for unequal coordinate variances.

misconception: Compute projection reconstruction error and retained variance for unequal coordinate variances.
objective: Compute projection reconstruction error and retained variance for unequal coordinate variances.

claims.text:
All finite inputs, equations, computed outputs and visual encodings: export function project(points:number[][],axis:number[]|null){const codes=points.map(p=>axis?p.reduce((sum,v,i)=>sum+v*axis[i],0):null),decoded=points.map((p,i)=>axis?axis.map(v=>v*codes[i]!):[...p]),errors=points.map((p,i)=>p.reduce((sum,v,j)=>sum+(v-decoded[i][j])**2,0)),variance=[0,1].map(i=>points.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p[i]**2,0)/points.length),retained=axis?axis.reduce((sum,v,i)=>sum+v*v*variance[i],0)/variance.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0):1;return {points,codes,decoded,errors,total:errors.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),variance,retained};}
export function run(mode:number){return project(mode===3?[[-1,-1],[-1,1],[1,-1],[1,1]]:[[-3,-1],[-1,1],[1,1],[3,-1]],mode===2?null:mode===1?[0,1]:[1,0]);}
